# Draft:Salt (The War Between the Land and the Sea)

Salt is a fictional character in Doctor Who spin-off series The War Between the Land and the Sea, portrayed as the ambassador of the Home Aqua, a faction of the Sea Devils. The character first appears in the series and is central to the ongoing conflict between land-based civilizations and aquatic species. Salt's diplomatic role and involvement in the war continue to be a major focus throughout the series.
